data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (origin, destination, date, passengers/class, Show flights, select fare) in the right order with mostly the right parameters, but it adds a vague "Book > Flights" opening step, a "trip type" step and an extra fare_type parameter, and it never says how to pick the cabin or how many of each passenger type, so an automation would need to guess some details.
